body:
commands.py:574-575: `gittoc log --limit -1` produces a confusing slice (lines[1:] or lines[:-1]) instead of an error; --limit 0 silently prints nothing.

Fix: reject N < 1 with a clear message, either via an argparse type function or an explicit check in cmd_log. Add a regression test for negative and zero values.
title: Validate log --limit is a positive integer
